rows.en: Then, Mikami…

Mm… That's fine!

From now on, the SSI will be merged into the TDF! Do your best, and don't fall behind the Ultra Garrison!
Dr. Deviler, leader of the Iron Mask Party, has been defeated. His brother Kenichiro has been avenged! And yet… Ken Kurenai's heart is not at ease.
Many who target this Earth still remain. Until every one of them is defeated and true peace is built, there will be no rest for any of the warriors, Ken Kurenai among them…
Whoa…!
Damn… I have to buy more time… or Operation Shadow is pointless… Uuugh…
Damn… the invincible Red Baron… Uuugh…
Defeat King Deviler!
Defeat King Deviler and all Gigants!
Defeat King Deviler, the Gigants and the Battleship Robot Iron Rocks…!
Defeat the Gigants and the Battleship Robot Iron Rocks!
Defeat the Gigants, the Kelbaan and the Battleship Robot Iron Rocks!
Defeat the Gigants, the Kelbaan, King Deviler and the Battleship Robot Iron Rocks!
Ken Kurenai is defeated
Ken Kurenai or Amagi is defeated
Ken Kurenai or Amagi is defeated
All allies are destroyed
That day was Aviation Day, a festival of the skies, you might say. One after another, the latest aircraft of every kind appeared, competing in their performances against the stage of the blue sky…
At young Daisaku's pleading, Science Patrol officers Akiko Fuji and Hayata had come to watch, together with Ultra Garrison officer Anne Yuri and the female Space Sheriff Annie.
Wow, that's amazing, so cool…
Daisaku… what's amazing is the way you're eating that popcorn. Give us some too!
Heh heh…

Oh?

My, it's a 400-seat supersonic airliner.
Wow, it's huge…
"Daisaku… It's odd for you, who controls Giant Robo, to be surprised by something like that, isn't it?"
Huh…!? Did someone just call me?
No one called you…

"Never mind…

It's only natural for airplanes to fly in the sky. Nothing interesting about that at all… So let me show you something interesting."
What's wrong!? Daisaku?
Well… I hear a voice, but nobody's there.
I don't hear anything. You're just hearing things…
Oh…!? What's that?
A ship…!? A ship is flying through the sky???

…!?

Look out! Quick, into the car!
"Daisaku… My power is quite something, isn't it? Hahahaha…"
HQ to Hayata… HQ to Hayata!
Hayata here…
We just saw the scene there on the live TV broadcast! What on earth happened? What caused it?

We don't know! It all happened so suddenly…

In any case… a ship came flying through the air, and it seems it collided with a plane doing a display flight at the festival and exploded.
All right, investigate the area around the scene!
It fell upward…!?

Yes…

"Falling upward" is an odd way to put it, but I believe that phenomenon occurred because of reverse gravity, so to speak… gravity working in reverse within a specific space.
Hmm… Come to think of it, even on TV it looked like it was being sucked up.
So the ship flying through the sky was also an effect of reverse gravity?
I wonder why it exploded?

Well, obviously…

Ships aren't built to fly through the sky. On top of that, it was loaded full of crude oil. Of course it exploded!
Hmm… But, Dr. Iwamoto!
It's certainly no mere natural phenomenon.
So then…?

Yes, Science Patrol here…

Huh…!? What did you say!?
Cap… It's the Space Development Base! They say they've received an SOS from the "Otori."
The "Otori"?
It's mankind's first Venus rocket. Its designer, Dr. Mori, is aboard; it should have left Earth last week…

And it's… sending an SOS? Why?

All right, Arashi… try contacting the "Otori"!

Sir…

This is the Science Patrol… Venus rocket "Otori," please respond!

Please respond! Please respond! Dr. Mori, please respond!

It's no use… Cap, there's no response.
But… what's this noise? Is some strange signal coming in?
It's Circuit 124875!

Arashi!

Connect it at once to the Pan-Space Interpreter I built!
Pan-Spa… What's that?

This is an emergency! There's no time to explain.

Let's just say, for now… it's a translator for every language in the universe!

Anyway… set it to Circuit 124875!

…………

All right, it's set!
Now, will it be a demon or a snake? Here goes!
Fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh!
Alien Baltan!?
Alien Baltan was supposed to have been wiped out by Ultraman, spaceship and all!

Our spaceship was blown up by Ultraman!

And with no time even to put up our light-wave barrier, we were bathed in the Specium Ray and nearly driven extinct!
So some of them survived!?
What's a light-wave barrier?
It's a sort of membrane… that reflects every kind of light wave and heat ray.
Huh…
You're creatures that can even make something like that?

At long last… we reached Planet R, a world we Baltans can inhabit.

But we are determined never to give up on the Earth! We challenge all of mankind!
Damn you, Baltan! So you're the ones who went after the "Otori"!

Yes, Science Patrol here…

Huh…!? Officer Anne has appeared? Where? 28th Street? Roger!
It's true… That's Officer Anne of the Ultra Garrison.
How on earth did this happen?

Yikes…

Still… a beauty is a beauty, even when she's giant!

But, Cap… she's not a kaiju, so we can't attack her, right?
Now what?

It's Annie…

Cap, it's Annie, the female Space Sheriff!
